# Design-system page layouts (`@fiscozen/layout`)

Declared by the design system itself in [`packages/layout/layouts.json`](https://github.com/fiscozen/design_system/blob/2837b83/packages/layout/layouts.json) @ `2837b83`.
Raw manifest materialised at `.claude/ds.layouts.json`. Component source for exact
prop/slot signatures: `.cache/design_system/packages/layout/src/`.

## How to choose (do this before writing any page)

1. **Pick exactly one shell.** Every page renders inside one top-level shell. The shell owns
   the viewport height, the scroll container and the device safe-area.
2. **Then ask whether the page shape needs a page-content layout inside it** — a list page, a
   record-detail page and a workspace page each have a dedicated one. The answer is usually a
   **pair** (shell + page-content), not a single layout.
3. **Apply the `When nested` column.** Nesting a page-content layout inside a shell that already
   owns a `main` landmark requires the listed props — skipping them produces duplicate landmarks.
4. **If the design's shape isn't clearly one of these, ask.** Do not pick by name similarity, and
   do not compose a page shell out of regions or the grid primitive.

Anything not in the target workspace's `package.json` yet installs with:

    pnpm add -F {workspace} {package}@{version}

## 1. Page shells — exactly one per page, at the router-view level

| Layout | Surface | When to use | Not for | Slots | Key props |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FzAppTemplate` | FO/BO | The standard application page: a persistent navigation rail (or top bar on mobile) beside the content, with optional sticky header, complementary aside panel, sticky bottom action bar and footer. The default choice for any signed-in page. | Not for a page whose nav rail itself collapses into a drawer — that is FzSidebarTemplate. Not for auth/login (FzBlankTemplate) or guided flows (FzFocusTemplate). | nav, header, default, aside, bottomBar, footer | hasAside, hasBottomBar, chrome, contentWidth, navLabel, asideLabel |
| `FzSidebarTemplate` | BO | Internal-tool / console app whose entire chrome is one persistent coloured side rail in three zones: brand at the top, scrollable navigation in the middle, the signed-in user pinned to the bottom. Below the desktop breakpoint the rail itself becomes an off-canvas drawer opened from a hamburger in a mobile top bar. | Not when the navigation stays persistent and an aside panel is what collapses — that is FzAppTemplate. The two are mirrors of each other; pick by asking which region disappears on mobile. | brand, nav, footer, topbar, default | navLabel, sidebarLabel, menuLabel |
| `FzFocusTemplate` | FO | A distraction-reduced flow: onboarding steps, guided wizards and auth screens. Centred content optionally framed by a top bar, a complementary aside (stacking below the content on narrow viewports) and a footer. | Not for an ordinary application page with navigation — that is FzAppTemplate. Use FzBlankTemplate instead when the screen needs no chrome at all. | topbar, default, aside, footer | chrome |
| `FzBlankTemplate` | FO/BO | A full-bleed page with no chrome whatsoever — one full-height content region and nothing else. For login/auth screens and standalone tools that render their own self-contained UI. | Not a way to opt out of navigation on a page that belongs inside the app shell. | default | align |

## 2. Page-content layouts — render inside a shell's content slot

Never top-level: these grow with their content and let the document scroll, so the shell must
own the height and safe-area.

| Layout | Surface | When to use | Not for | Nest inside | When nested | Slots | Key props |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FzListTemplate` | BO | A list page: an optional full-width banner (alerts, action cards), an optional filter rail, an optional toolbar (title/search/actions) and the list itself, typically an FzTable. Each region renders only when its slot is filled. | Not a split-view master-detail (list beside a navigable detail pane) — that shape still uses the FzLayout leftShoulder grid variant. Not a page shell: it must render inside one. | `FzAppTemplate`, `FzSidebarTemplate` | mainAs="div"; the shell already owns the <main> landmark; also set filtersLabel when the shell renders its own aside, so the filter rail and the shell's panel are distinguishable complementary landmarks | banner, filters, header, default | filtersPosition, filtersLabel, mainAs |
| `FzDetailTemplate` | BO | A record-detail page: a persistent summary/context rail (the record's identity, status, meta and actions) beside the record's content (typically FzTabs or FzCards), with an optional full-width banner and an optional toolbar. The sibling of FzListTemplate — a list pairs a filter rail with a table, a detail page pairs a summary rail with the record. | Not a page shell: it must render inside one. If the rail holds filters rather than a record summary, the page is a list — use FzListTemplate. | `FzAppTemplate`, `FzSidebarTemplate` | mainAs="div"; the shell already owns the <main> landmark; also set sidebarLabel when the shell renders its own aside. The toolbar region is deliberately a plain container, not a banner landmark — the shell owns the page banner | banner, sidebar, toolbar, default | sidebarLabel, mainAs |

## 3. Bounded-height layouts — require a bounded-height ancestor

**These fill their parent's height and scroll their regions internally. Mounted in a box with
an indefinite height they collapse to zero and never scroll.** Only use one inside a host listed
in `Nest inside`; if that column says *unverified*, ask before using it.

| Layout | Surface | When to use | Not for | Nest inside | When nested | Slots | Key props |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FzThreeColumnsTemplate` | BO | A review workspace page (e.g. accounting document approval): a full-width header bar, a collapsible list/navigation sidebar, and two equal-width content columns — a left preview column and a right column with its own header and an independently scrollable body. | Not the same thing as FzLayout's layout="threeColumns" variant, which is a CSS-grid primitive with menu/header/chat/main/footer regions. Not for a page that should scroll as one document — that is FzListTemplate or FzDetailTemplate. | **unverified — ask** | — | header-left, header-right, sidebar-header, sidebar-filter, sidebar-content, column-left, column-right-header, column-right-content | sidebarCollapsed, mainAs, sidebarLabel |

## 4. Not for app code

| Component | Kind | Why not | Use instead |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FzLayout` | grid | Not a page layout — do not build a page shell out of it. Its leftShoulder variant forces 100vh mobile tracks and independent per-region scroll, which is why the list/detail layouts compose region molecules with document scroll instead. | a page layout above for page structure; FzContainer for in-page composition |
| `FzLayoutMain` | region | Not for app code. The composing layout applies its sizing and padding via fall-through attributes, so using it directly means re-implementing a page layout by hand. | a page layout above — regions are internal to them |
| `FzLayoutHeader` | region | Not for app code — see FzLayoutMain. | a page layout above — regions are internal to them |
| `FzLayoutAside` | region | Not for app code — see FzLayoutMain. | a page layout above — regions are internal to them |
| `FzLayoutFooter` | region | Not for app code — see FzLayoutMain. | a page layout above — regions are internal to them |
| `FzLayoutBottomBar` | region | Not for app code. To put content in the bar, inject FZ_BOTTOM_BAR_TARGET and teleport into it, or fill the shell's bottomBar slot. | a page layout above — regions are internal to them |

Region wrappers are composed **by** the page layouts, which apply their sizing and padding
internally. Reaching for one directly in app code means re-implementing a layout by hand.

## Verified compositions

| Shell | Accepts inside its content slot |
| --- | --- |
| `FzAppTemplate` | `FzListTemplate`, `FzDetailTemplate` |
| `FzSidebarTemplate` | `FzListTemplate`, `FzDetailTemplate` |

A pair not listed here has not been verified. Ask rather than assuming the height contracts compose.

## ⚠ Compose-only gaps — read before committing to one of these

This repo's styling policy is **compose-only**: no `class` / `:class` / `style` / `:style` /
`<style>` anywhere, enforced at write time. The layouts below document capabilities that are
currently reachable **only** through a fall-through `class`/`style` on the layout root, so
those capabilities are **not available in this repo**.

Surface this in the component plan *before* implementing. Do not work around it with a class —
the write will be blocked. Note the divergence, or pick a different layout.

- **`FzAppTemplate`** — the page background is reachable only through a fall-through `class` on the template root (the README example uses class="bg-[#f7f6f3]"); RFC §4 planned a `background` prop that was not shipped — shipped props are hasAside/hasBottomBar/chrome/contentWidth/navLabel/asideLabel
- **`FzSidebarTemplate`** — sidebar colours and width are reachable only through the `--fz-sidebar-bg` / `--fz-sidebar-text` / `--fz-sidebar-width` custom properties set on the template root, which needs `style` or `class`; the fallbacks are #fff / inherit / 280px, so under compose-only the rail renders unthemed and a design with a coloured sidebar cannot be implemented; the page background is reachable only through a fall-through `class` on the template root
- **`FzThreeColumnsTemplate`** — it fills its parent's height and requires a bounded-height ancestor, which a compose-only consumer cannot create: FzContainer exposes no height/viewport prop (tag, alignItems, main, gap, horizontal, layout). Mounted in a box with an indefinite height it collapses to zero and its regions never scroll — and no host is verified yet, so nestWithin is deliberately empty
